| bds_isobus_rxCallback_tpf | ISOBUS receive callback function. | func_pf         | Pointer to a callback function of data type isobus_rxCallback_tpf which is called after a new message was received completely. The execution time of the callback function should be short to be able to meet the time conditions within the ISOBUS stack. |
